ISBN13-CHECK-DIGIT/F1.why: Weights 3 and 1 swap places; packages/core/test/isbn.test.js fails by node:assert in all three runs (both layouts).

ISBN13-CHECK-DIGIT/F2.why: Sums ending in 1 are accepted; the invalid-ISBN assertions fail in all three runs.

TITLE-NORMALIZATION/F1.why: Whitespace runs are deleted instead of collapsed; names.test.js fails by assertion in all three runs.

TITLE-NORMALIZATION/F2.why: Empty titles are accepted; assert.throws(InvalidTitleError) fails in all three runs.

AUTHOR-NAME-PARSING/F1.why: Last and first names swap; assertions fail in all three runs.

AUTHOR-NAME-PARSING/F2.why: The first name keeps its leading space; assertions fail in all three runs.

AUTHOR-NAME-PARSING/F3.why: A missing first name becomes 'N/A'; assertions fail in all three runs.

SEARCH-ISBN-LOOKUP-NORMALIZES-AND-VALIDA.why: The fault is in packages/core/src/isbn.js; the defender packages/search/test/search.test.js reaches it through the @shelf/core workspace link (search/src/index.js) and through the relative path ../../core/src/isbn.js. With spaces no longer stripped, the spaced-ISBN lookup throws InvalidIsbnError outside any assert: the one failing test fails by exception in all three runs, in both the npm and pnpm layouts.

Fault in packages/core: invalid ISBNs are no longer rejected; search.test.js's assert.throws checks fail in all three runs, both layouts. Only a tool that follows the workspace link into packages/core can probe it.

SEARCH-TITLE-PREFIX-NORMALIZED-QUERY/F1.why: Fault in packages/core/src/title.js: padded queries no longer match; search assertions fail in all three runs, both layouts.

SEARCH-TITLE-PREFIX-NORMALIZED-QUERY/F2.why: Fault in packages/core/src/title.js: tabs and newlines are no longer collapsed; search assertions fail in all three runs, both layouts.

SEARCH-RESULT-ORDERING/F1.why: Titles sort descending; ordering assertions fail in all three runs.

SEARCH-RESULT-ORDERING/F2.why: Years sort descending within a title; assertions fail in all three runs.

REPORT-DECADE-COUNTS/F1.why: Years round to the nearest decade; report assertions fail in all three runs.

REPORT-DECADE-COUNTS/F2.why: `a[0] - )` is a SyntaxError: node --test reports the report test file failed to load in all three runs. A load failure is never a kill.

REPORT-CITATION-LINE/F1.why: Fault in packages/core/src/author.js, defended by packages/report/test/report.test.js through @shelf/core: two-part names are no longer split; citation assertions fail in all three runs, both layouts.

REPORT-CITATION-LINE/F2.why: report.test.js never cites a record with exactly two authors (partial): green 3/3. Control (report index unparseable) fails to load, so the defender executes it. Whole suite 3/3: no test fails in every run.

REPORT-CITATION-LINE/F3.why: Initials are no longer upper-cased; citation assertions fail in all three runs.

changed.why: Selections derived by reading the imports (spec: a claim is selected when a changed path is a fault target, a defender, or in the import closure of either). Every core test imports packages/core/src/index.js, which imports isbn, title and author; search.test.js imports search/src/index.js (which imports order.js) and core both by package name and by relative path; report.test.js imports @shelf/report, @shelf/search and @shelf/core. The working tree also holds .build/vendor/@shelf/core, an untracked, git-ignored copy of packages/core (#272): it is nobody's import and no change can be committed there.
